Name: Palácio da Pena
Cost Range: 20 EUR adult (Essential Visit); reduced youth band - check
Tips: BOOKED & paid - Essential Visit, 20 EUR adult, 09:00 palace slot. Taxi/Bolt up from Sintra station (~10-15 EUR total for 4) - first 434 bus is too late. 09:00 is the PALACE door, 15-25 min uphill from the park gate; enter within ~30 min of slot or forfeit.

Name: Castelo dos Mouros
Tips: 8th-century Moorish walls, 10 min from Pena's gate. Huge Atlantic views. On-site booth closed - buy the ticket at the Pena ticket office. Forest path down to the village (~25 min, shaded) is the day's best walk.

Name: Casa Piriquita
Tips: Travesseiros and queijadas. Sintra institution since 1862. ~12:45 lunch stop.

Name: Quinta da Regaleira
Cost Range: 20 EUR adult / 15 EUR youth 6-17 (2026 prices; 19-y-o pays adult)
Tips: BOOK NOW - timed 30-min slots, August afternoons sell out; aim for 14:00 at regaleira.pt. Initiation Well - 27m spiral descent into tunnels. Bring your phone torch.

Name: Cabo da Roca
Tips: Westernmost point of continental Europe. Bus 1624 (ex-403, Carris Metropolitana) from Sintra station ~16:30, 2.60 EUR on board - check exact time in the app. Windy and cold - bring layers.

Name: Cascais
Tips: Marina walk, Boca do Inferno sea-arch, fish dinner on the front. Bus 1624 continues here from Cabo da Roca; train home to Cais do Sodré 2.30 EUR (~40 min).

Name: Sintra Mitos e Lendas
Tips: Optional air-conditioned add-on by the Piriquita lunch stop - 17 multimedia rooms of Sintra legends. Daily 10:00-18:30, last entry 17:30. Swap-in if Castelo dos Mouros gets cut.
